interpretation.name: ShareNutrunnerWithLine2
interpretation.goal: Bring the shared nutrunner NR7 from the crib to station st2 and tighten, evaluate and record the fasteners of variant F30. Then return NR7 to the crib and release it so that line 3 can reserve it.
constraints: NR7 must be reserved by line 2 before any transport or use, and released only after it is back in the crib (E1, E6)
transport-tool Steps must be executed by agvexecutor (E2)
NR7 must be at st2 before configure-tool or tighten-fasteners is invoked (E3)
The tightening program for F30 is obtained only via get-program; no torque, tolerance or bolt-count literals in the Recipe (E4)
Every tightening is evaluated against its program and recorded for traceability (E5)
Every tool-using Step depends on reserve-tool for lease renewal; the 120 s lease exceeds every single tool-using Step (transport-tool 90 s, tighten-fasteners 60 s) (E6, E9)
interpretation.preference: Minimize the time NR7 is away from the crib: fetch the program in parallel with the outbound transport, start the return transport right after tightening, and run evaluation and recording in parallel with the return transport.
interpretation.horizon: Current request only, until NR7 is back in the crib and released for line 3.
